question.text: Saksham Skills Pvt Ltd reports its SIA using the 'Theory of Change' method. Which chain of elements does a Theory of Change map correctly depict?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that an organisation using the Theory of Change method can express impact through a map showing input, output, outcome and impact. This is the standard chain depicted on a ToC map. The Trap: Option A is a P&L chain, Option B is an accounting identity, and Option C is an investment-analytics chain — none of these is a Theory of Change chain. Note: Pin the Input → Output → Outcome → Impact chain at the top of any ToC workpaper to keep indicator placement disciplined.
